fusions.name: Short Fuse
fusions.desc: Throws a lit fuse that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that damage.

fusions.name: Slow Match
fusions.desc: Sweeps a smouldering cord through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 12 damage to everything in it and sets each target [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slag Shackles
fusions.desc: Burns through up to 3 conditions that hold or stun you, and you move 25% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spark at the End
fusions.desc: When one of your conditions on an enemy runs out, the fuse has burnt down and a spark jumps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles. The spark deals 8 damage and sets that enemy [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
